blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `aria-label` supplies a name to assistive technology. It should explain the same purpose as the visible control or graphic.
`overflow-x: auto` gives this region sideways scrolling only when its content needs more width.
`max-width: 100%` stops the image or box growing wider than its available parent width.

blocks.text: On a narrow screen, only the table region can scroll sideways. Its name explains the region to a reading tool.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Keep table headers and the caption. Do not turn a data table into unlabeled boxes just to fit it.
